verdict.rationale: DeepSeek documents streaming through the `stream=true` parameter in both OpenAI and Anthropic formats. Its Rate Limit page also describes one latency-related behavior: streaming requests receive continuous SSE keep-alive comments under load. Beyond that, latency behavior is thinly documented. Missing for 10: documented time-to-first-token or latency figures, any sub-second or fast-response guarantees, token-level streaming format details, and independent hands-on corroboration of streaming latency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream responses token by token (or get sub-second full answers) with the latency behavior documented

citations.quote: you can set the `stream` parameter to `true` to get stream response
